references.text: Describes the daily burnt offering (tamid) to which the Sabbath burnt offering is added
Previous verse specifying the actual Sabbath burnt offering with two one-year-old male lambs, flour, and oil
The basis for the daily burnt offering to which the Sabbath offering is added
Ezekiel's description of the Sabbath burnt offering in the future temple
Solomon plans to build the temple to offer burnt offerings on the Sabbaths as prescribed
David's arrangement for burnt offerings on the Sabbaths according to the Lord's statutes
